stories.h: Magnitude 3.4 earthquake near Auburn felt across Puget Sound
stories.s: A M3.4 quake centered near Lea Hill, northeast of Auburn, struck just after 11 p.m. Friday. USGS logged nearly 1,700 felt reports; no damage was reported.

stories.h: Eastbound SR 18 closes tonight; I-90 Bellevue lanes close next
stories.s: All eastbound SR 18 lanes close 9-11 p.m. Sunday between Issaquah-Hobart Road and I-90. Up to three I-90 lanes each way close overnight Mon-Tue in Bellevue, with several ramps shut.

stories.h: SeaTac man accused of contacting 911 about 1,400 times
stories.s: SeaTac police arrested a 35-year-old man accused of calling and texting 911 roughly 1,400 times over three days over a protective-order dispute, tying up King County dispatchers. He faces misdemeanor charges.

coming.h: King tides peak on Puget Sound around Thanksgiving
coming.s: Supermoon-boosted king tides are expected to peak in Puget Sound around Thanksgiving and Black Friday; forecasters don't expect extreme flooding but low-lying shorelines could see water.
